bus.via: Wynyard Station, Carrington St, Stand A to Manly Wharf, West Promenade, Stand J

trips.route_note: Take the Manly Ferry from Circular Quay (about 30 minutes) straight to Manly Wharf, then walk or take a local bus to the beach.
see: Manly to Shelly Beach coastal path
trips.tour_query: Manly ferry and beach day trip from Sydney
trips.why: The bus is quick and frequent, dropping you right at Manly Wharf near the beach.
know: The ferry from Circular Quay is a scenic alternative
Manly Beach is a classic first-time Sydney experience
Weekends and summer get busy, so go early

bus.via: Town Hall, Park St, Stand H to Blacktown Station, Stand D

trips.route_note: Catch a Western Line train from Central to Blacktown (about 45 minutes), then a local bus to the Featherdale Wildlife Park entrance.
see: Featherdale Wildlife Park koalas and kangaroos
trips.tour_query: Featherdale Wildlife Park day trip from Sydney
trips.why: The train to Blacktown is faster than the bus and connects to a local bus for Featherdale Wildlife Park.
know: Featherdale Wildlife Park is the main draw for first-time visitors
Trains run frequently on the Western Line from Central
Allow extra time for the local bus connection to the park
